entities.summary: Nicolai Apollonovich Baikov was an officer of the imperial Russian army, and explorer, a naturalist and a hunter. He spent many years in Manchuria and wrote numerous books on the region. Many of these have been translated into East Asian languages, but only Big Game Hunting in Manchuria was published in English.
